label: E-classes and e-nodes
subgoals: Represent each operator application as an e-node over child e-classes
Maintain hashconsing and congruence under merges

label: Saturation
subgoals: Match each rule's left-hand side against the e-graph
Add the right-hand side and merge it into the matched class
Repeat until nothing new is added or the budget is spent

label: Extraction and soundness
subgoals: Choose one e-node per needed class to minimize cost
Use dynamic programming for tree cost and integer programming for DAG cost
Guard rules with width conditions and check the result for equivalence
